name: WeShareAI – AI-Powered Share Buttons (formerly E-MAILiT)
author: NIKITAS GEORGOPOULOS

sections.description:
WeShareAI is a free, lightweight WordPress plugin that adds AI-powered, privacy-first share buttons to your website.

Formerly known as E-MAILiT, WeShareAI builds on more than a decade of development in social sharing technology, now reimagined for modern publishers. The plugin is designed to load fast, respect user privacy, and work seamlessly with any WordPress theme — without heavy admin panels or intrusive tracking.

Configuration is handled via the external WeShareAI Builder, allowing you to generate your share buttons, choose platforms, and optionally enable post-share monetization — all without bloating your WordPress admin area.

Key Features

  • AI-powered smart share buttons
  • Privacy-first architecture (no PII, no user profiling)
  • External builder – no heavy WordPress admin UI
  • Works with any WordPress theme
  • Optional post-share monetization (Thank You Page ads)
  • Universal Bypass: enhance existing share buttons
  • Lightweight, asynchronous loading
  • Free to use

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Generate your share button code via the WeShareAI Builder.
  3. Place the buttons on your site using shortcodes, widgets, or theme templates.
  4. Optionally enable post-share monetization features.

Privacy First

WeShareAI is built with privacy at its core.

  • No selling of user data
  • No personal user profiling
  • No invasive tracking
  • Fully GDPR-aware by design

Your users share content — not their personal information.
sections.installation:
Automatic installation:

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “WeShareAI”.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.

Manual installation:

  1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org.
  2. Upload the e-mailit folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu.
sections.faq:
Do I need to edit HTML or JavaScript?

No. Configuration is handled through the WeShareAI Builder.

Does this plugin slow down my site?

No. Scripts load asynchronously and do not block page rendering.

Can I use it with any theme?

Yes. WeShareAI works with any WordPress theme.

Is the plugin really free?

Yes. The plugin is free. Optional post-share monetization is available for publishers who choose to enable it.
sections.changelog: See changelog.txt in the plugin directory for the full changelog.
